fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects DLL sideloading of DLLs that are part of Microsoft Office from non standard location
fields.name: Microsoft Office DLL Sideload
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\outllib.dll" and (not (module.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\OFFICE" or module.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\OFFICE" or module.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\Root\\OFFICE" or module.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\Root\\OFFICE"))))
